Changing `provider` after scaffold does NOT install that agent's surface — re-run `codeyam-editor editor install-hooks` (or `codeyam-editor init --provider <name>`) to install it. See CLAUDE.md or run `codeyam-editor editor config-show` to inspect the effective config.
projectDescription:
Build a rent the runway for workwear. 

Subsription-based rental app for work clothing. 

This app is for new graduates entering the workforce. They’re younger men and women building out their work wardrobe. 

Imagine users on both their phone and computer.

It’d also be helpful to see deals from brands (see brands that are on sale so they could potentially rent or purchase clothing). 

Users should be able to upload a picture of themselves and be able to “try on” clothes digitally to be able to virtually try on an outfit or piece of clothing before they commit to renting or buying it.

Ability to add current clothing and style outfits; ability to upload photos or search clothes they have and mark as currently owned.

Being able to look up their employer’s dress code and make sure their professional attire is ‘on brand’ for their company’s policy. And if there’s changes to policy, accommodate it.

Have a subscription with membership tiers with different benefits so they can choose a tier appropriate.

Ability to upload inspiration (e.g. a pinterest board). 

Make it an easy and intuitive interface. Do not want the experience  to be complex or overwhelming. 

Have a modern, potentially feminine aesthetic that still feels corporate and put together.
